name: Gently cup and lift — contact simulation
description: The Sharpa Wave hand comes in at rest, swoops down at the glass rolling palm-up, slides its index and middle fingers under the bloom to the middle knuckles, closes the V on the stem, cups the flower where it stands, lifts it straight out of the water and carries it up and forward, the wrist turning to bring the bloom to the eye.

solver.physics: MuJoCo 3.3.4: free-body contact dynamics; no attachment constraints
solver.controller: 29 torque-limited position servos; Isaac Sharpa cradle trajectory retargeted after gravity settling
solver.water: Lumped water mass, submerged-stem buoyancy and viscous drag; no fluid solver

phases.label: Close the V on the stem
